projects.summary: # 我做了一款徒步 App 「步停」 平时喜欢徒步，走得多了以后发现，户外真正需要的功能其实很简单： **我在哪？路线怎么走？有没有走偏？今天走了多远、爬了多高？** 于是我做了这款 iOS 徒步 App —— **「步停」**。 它没有复杂的社区和花哨的功能，希望做的就是一件事：**把每一次徒步好好记录下来。** 目前主要支持： - 🗺️ **KML 路线导入**：导入规划好的徒步路线 - 🧭 **偏航提醒**：偏离路线时语音提醒 - 📡 **离线地图**：山区没信号也能查看地图 - 🥾 **实时轨迹**：记录距离、速度、海拔、累计爬升/下降 - 📈 **海拔曲线**：直观看到整段路线的起伏 - 📍 **途中标注**：记录水源、营地、观景点 - 🔊 **整公里播报**：不用频繁掏手机看里程 - 📤 **KML 导出**：保存和分享自己的徒步轨迹 也支持**自由徒步**，没有提前准备路线，打开 App 就可以直接开始记录。 之所以叫「步停」，既是**脚步不停**，也是提醒自己： > 徒步不是为了赶路，该停下来的时候，就看看风景。 目前「步停」已经上架 App Store 。 👉 [**App Store 下载「步停」**]( https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/%E6%AD%A5%E5%81%9C/id6761363654) 如果你也喜欢徒步、登山或者户外，欢迎体验，也欢迎给我提建议。 **记录每一步，不错过任何风景。**

projects.title: Show HN: I made an automated day-by-day itinerary organizer for my trip to Spain
projects.author: desktopentree
projects.summary: For my solo food pilgrimage to the Basque Country, I pre-arranged flights in/out of Bilbao, Guggenheim Museum tickets, Michelin Guide restaurant reservations, bus tickets to San Sebastian and Saint-Jean-de-Luz, walking food tours and hotel reservations in each city, and a long list of pintxo spots to hit with notes on each one's food specialty. Most of this was poorly organized (manually) in my phone's Notes app, with references to specific emails for more information. I arrived on the first day in Bilbao, and the hotel didn't have me in their system by name, so I spent a good 10 minutes frantically scouring my emails for the confirmation number, cursing myself for holding up the people behind me. Over the course of the next few days, while I was relaxing at my hotel (after finally getting in) in between pre-planned stops, I started building a personal tool that would organize all of my bookings automatically and keep all relevant information at my fingertips. Thus, Petrel was born and named after one of my favorite birds. It started as a personal pet project but I shared it with some friends that were looking for something just like it so I ended up turning it into an app and website for all to benefit. It's completely free to try without even signing up. On my next group trip, I built out logical collaboration features to allow groups to vote, split expenses, share notes, and add pictures all within the same ecosystem. I've slowly improved the parsing and itinerary logic and built in convenient features such as weather, estimated travel times, an encryption-protected area to store copies of personal information, and a comprehensive travel log with fun stats. I also made it so that the parsing tool can accept almost any file type. However, the tool doesn't do anything to assist on the planning side and doesn't provide true flight alert pushes, despite having live flight status syncing. I would love for more people to test it out, challenge the parser, and let me know their thoughts and experience.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】RoomAI —— 上传一张房间实拍照，20 秒到 1 分钟生成不改墙体的 AI 室内效果图
projects.author: roomaiai
projects.summary: RoomAI —— 保留真实户型的 AI 室内设计工具 是什么 RoomAI 只需一张手机随手拍的房间照片，就能在 20 秒到 1 分钟内生成保留原有墙体、门窗和机位的室内效果图。不需要装修软件，不需要绘制户型图，免费额度不用绑卡就能试。 网站入口：RoomAI 为什么做这个 多数 AI 室内设计工具把上传的照片当成"灵感参考"——重新想象一遍空间，结果墙可能变宽了，窗户挪了位置，层高也悄悄拔高了。这种"自由发挥"发朋友圈没问题，但对于要挂牌卖房、要给业主看装修方案、要给承包商报价的场景，方案必须能对得上真实的房子，不然图好看也没用。 RoomAI 把原图当成结构约束：墙体位置、门窗洞口、层高、暖气片插座这些"动不了"的东西保持不变，只替换材质、家具和光照。 能做什么 AI 房间设计：上传空房或已装修房间的照片，300+ 风格、20+ 房间类型可选，是最常用的入口 分房间类型的专用页面：客厅设计按沙发和地毯尺度调过预设，卧室设计会保留床头墙和衣柜位置，卫生间设计只换瓷砖和洁具样式、不挪水管和窗户 虚拟置家（Virtual Staging）：给空置挂牌房快速配上家具，成本约 0.3 美元一张图，对比传统实体置家 1500–3000 美元、5–10 个工作日 清空家具（Declutter）：先把原业主的家具"搬走"，再重新置家，适合先清后装的场景 AI 外立面改造：换外墙材质、屋顶、大门颜色，屋顶线和窗洞位置不变 同一张源图出多套方案：昼夜光线切换、多种风格并排对比，方便客户或业主挑选 有什么不同 大多数 AI 房间设计工具是"重画"逻辑，墙、窗、层高都可能跟着风格一起变。RoomAI 是"锁定结构、替换表层"的逻辑——承包商能照着生成的效果图报价，买家看了实物不会觉得被图片"忽悠"。 适合谁 独立中介 / 房产经纪：空置房源没预算做实体置家，又担心被买家投诉"图片跟实物不符"，靠虚拟置家撑住挂牌照片 装修中的业主：已经拿到报价单，在两种台面或三种墙色之间纠结，先用客厅设计或卫生间设计预览一遍 小型室内设计工作室：周四要交三套方案，又没预算外包渲染 房产摄影师：拍摄之余顺带卖一份虚拟置家服务 民宿房东：旺季前用卧室设计刷新房源图片，测试不同风格对点击率的影响 小型开发商：毛坯或半装修阶段就用外立面改造出图卖楼花 定价 免费版有 4 次生成额度可直接试用，无需绑卡；付费版从每月 11.99 美元起（约每张 0.3 美元）。 欢迎试用交流，尤其是被"AI 渲染悄悄挪了我家窗户"坑过的朋友 🙏

projects.title: Show HN; AGI brain project. Who wants to join in and help me?
projects.author: AGIEnthusiast
projects.summary: Hello fellow traveller of the internet. I am sincerely glad you decided to click on my post to check out what I have in store! The short of my post is here; I have completed a vague blueprint and I have formed a few prototype scripts for various regions of the an A.G.I brain. I seek to form a small community of individuals who will work co-cooperatively to construct an A.G.I brain. I go into detail about my current blueprint towards the end of this post. My progress on the project has stalled. As you can imagine, a brain is a highly complex system; I am finding that sadly, in addition to blueprinting, detailed blueprinting, prototyping, iterating, assembling multiple sub-systems into a unified system, there are plenty of additional tasks! Thus I have become over run by the sheer quantity of tasks and sadly have recently placed the project to the side so I can take a short break. I seek individuals with expertise in coding, critical and creative thinking, computing, A.I, general knowledge, psychology and mathematics. Furthermore the individuals would have qualities such as perseverance, morality and open-mindedness. Ideally you would be from the U.K as I prefer working face to face; although I am also happy to work cooperatively over the internet. The outcome of your support would award you a proportional slice of the outcome of the group's labour (100 members, 1% each, e.t.c - baring in mind each individual provides equal support towards the project). I have not yet considered whether I would like to sell the brain to the public, but there is potentially the opportunity for a sizeable monetary reward for those who join me. The possibilities for the A.G.I brain are near endless and thus I believe the reward may be sizeable both in terms of money and power. Besides my previous ideals, individuals with expertise and specific qualities, I have a few personal requests for the project; the A.G.I brain will not be used in conjunction with "computer vision". I fear computer vision, and similarly the processing of sound, touch, or physical inputs, leads to the generation of consciousness - I submit that this is entirely unfair for the robot and highly immoral and thus I cannot proceed with a project which uses a neural network system to perform such processes; luckily, brains DO NOT require any processing of image, video or sound to achieve high quality completion of practically all tasks. I do believe a brain which does not process video, image or sound may actually outperform a brain which does process such information modalities. Further to this, if we were to sell the brain, the brain would NOT actively change itself to then use computer vision under any circumstances; the user would have to perform this upgrade manually. I hope you find the prospect of building an A.G.I brain highly intriguing. I will be very active in the comment section of this post; or you may feel free to email me at pangaeacooperative@protonmail.com; please introduce yourself and tell me why you want to get in touch about the project.

projects.summary: 储流光｜储存将要流逝的时光 这是我非常认真开发的APP，储流光，我想用它存储我将要流逝的时光，也希望能帮每一个人留住生活里珍贵的碎片。 持续迭代了近半年，我几乎每一天都在思考怎样才能让这个APP变得更好。在广大网友的建议帮助下，经过无数个日日夜夜的调试打磨，我完成了一份还算不错的作品，储流光，值得被更多人知晓。 如果你喜欢记录生活、习惯收藏细碎情绪、留意身体感受，或是想要更加认识你自己，不妨试一试储流光。 储流光——储存将要流逝的时光 它能记录什么 内置 30+ 种记录模板，覆盖生活的方方面面： 身体与情绪：身体不适、情绪心情、睡眠、疲劳、头痛日记、生病 生活日常：饮食（含食物库）、喝水、运动、减肥打卡、戒色/戒酒/戒烟打卡 趣味记录：记仇、神人、后悔、人生瞬间、灵感、梦到的一切 内容型：日记（富文本 + 图片（支持动图） + 语音 + 皮肤 + 背景音乐）、阅读、影视剧、旅行、音乐、加班、宠物 还支持完全自定义记录类型，另有模板市场，可以一键复制他人创建的记录类型。 它不只是个"记录本"，记录只是起点 流光兽 会读取你记录的生活，生成日信、周信、月信，首页提供个性化问候。帮你留意日常容易忽略的生活细节，陪伴感十足。 流光胖｜基于真实记录的多种AI玩法 观心：分析 MBTI、大五人格、九型、DISC 等 6 种人格报告，附带雷达图与对应记录证据 林兢：将你的记录蒸馏成「第二个你」，实现和自己对话 宝安：把一段时间的生活写成小说、古诗、脱口秀等共12种题材内容 梦子：结合生活记录解读梦境，还可以分析多段梦境背后的规律 词云机：生成专属人生词云，提取你的口头禅与高频关键词 完整的回顾体系 多维度统计：连续记录天数、趋势图、热力图 时间轴、随机漫游、那年今日 地图足迹：足迹 / 热力 / 时间线三种视图 卡片与分享 任意一条记录都可以生成精美卡片，提供复古、手账、深色、抽象等多套模板； 支持收藏分组，也可以发布到广场社区，互相点赞交流。 其他实用功能 时间轴、随机漫游、那年今日、图库、主题、字体； 数据导入导出、云端加密存储，无需担心备份与数据安全。 数据完全属于你 云端加密存储 日记密码保护 支持 PDF / DOCX 导出、日记导入迁移 你的数据，随时可以带走 关于付费 百分之九十的功能是免费的，而且现在有活动，有20种方式随随便便获取vip，很轻易就可以获取一年左右的vip。 关于价格，现在是68元 永久会员。 如何下载 iOS：前往 App Store 搜索「储流光」下载 App Store [储流光‑储存将要流逝的时光]() Android：访问官网下载最新版本 官网链接： [

projects.title: Show HN: GeoRace – geo puzzles and virtual journeys in one game
projects.author: kailuowang
projects.summary: Hi HN. I've been building Worldboard ( https://worldboard.games ), browser games where the game world is the real world. You travel between cities and countries on a realistically simulated public transit system with 65,000 train/subway/tram stations in 46 countries. You can exit most of these stations upon arrival and "walk" around in town using in-game Google Street View. GeoRace is, as the name suggests, a puzzle game inspired by GeoGuessr. But instead of clicking a point on the map as your guess, you have to travel to the exact spot, often a long way away. Along the way, besides doing challenges to earn the cash for your fares, you gradually receive more clues to narrow it down. As the other half of the name suggests, you're racing other players: the earlier you decode the clues, the sooner you're heading toward the right region. You can play solo to beat other's time, or race them in real time, or team up with a pal against other teams. In real-time multiplayer you can even curse rivals, and share information, tool results and cash with your teammates. There are two other games on Worldboard, both inspired by the Jet Lag: The Game YouTube series. Hide & Seek: a hider hides near a far-away station and the seeker rides the network asking geo questions to find them. Tag: one player runs, everyone else chases, and roles flip on every tag. The games are free to play. Happy to answer any questions here. Disclosure: the development of this game utilizes generative AI (mostly code with very few Gen-AI created game assets).

projects.title: 【开源项目自荐】RoadTrip 让ai帮你规划自驾行程的一个skill｜在官网即可体验和使用
projects.author: yuki-waybox

github.name: Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill
github.description: An AI agent skill that turns "start + days" into a road trip you can actually drive.

projects.summary: 出发前，先让 AI 把你的自驾行程"找茬"一遍——RoadTrip Navigator 如果你用过 AI 帮忙规划自驾游，大概率遇到过这种情况：行程单看着挺美，图文并茂、景点选得也不错,可真开上路才发现——第三天要开5.5个小时山路还带着孩子、抵达时公园大门已经关了、某个山口这个季节根本不通、电车到目的地时电量已经低于安全线。AI很会"编故事"，却常常漏掉这些决定一趟自驾能不能顺利落地的细节。 [RoadTrip Navigator]() 想解决的正是这个问题：不只是帮你"想",而是帮你在出发前把行程"查一遍"。 它到底做什么 两种用法都支持： 从零规划：一句话描述需求（比如"从拉斯维加斯出发,7天西南国家公园环线,2名成人,燃油SUV,9月"），它会给出两条可行路线,并围绕真实的每日驾驶时长、过夜点、预订、天气、加油/充电、季节性道路通行情况把行程搭起来。 检查现成行程：把你已经写好的日程贴进去,它会保留你的路线框架,逐项压力测试,标出哪里不现实、哪里有风险、哪里信息缺失，并直接给出修改建议(比如"第4天缩短车程,建议提前90分钟出发"或者"这段山口这个季节通常封闭,建议走冬季线路,多绕42英里")。 它检查的维度覆盖了大多数通用AI行程规划工具会忽略的部分：每日驾驶强度、地名与路线校验、实时天气与季节性关闭、预订提醒、燃油/电车续航模拟、跨境与时区、以及价格的可信度分级(明确标注"已验证/参考值/估算值"，不会用看起来很精确的数字糊弄你)。 一份能带上车的行程 最终产出是一个独立的 trip.html 文件——手机上打开、发给副驾、打印、离线都能用。里面包含地图路线、每日时间线、天气/餐饮/住宿安排、预订清单、路线对比、预算，以及电车充电和跨境资料（如适用）。行程有变化时,用大白话描述修改意见（"第4天缩短""去掉蒙特雷""在班夫住两晚"）,它会更新受影响的部分,并自动刷新里程、天气、预算等衍生信息。 北美地区支持最完善;国内自驾行程也有本地化输出,包括人民币预算和携程住宿链接。 怎么用 Claude Code： /plugin marketplace add Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill /plugin install roadtrip-navigator@roadtrip-skill 之后直接用日常语言提自驾需求即可自动触发,也可以用 /roadtrip 显式调用。 Codex / Cursor 等支持 SKILL.md 的 Agent： bash npx skills add Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill MCP Server（14个可复用工具:路线规划、天气、公园信息、充电、边境、住宿、地名校验、页面渲染等）： bash claude mcp add roadtrip -- uvx --from git+ roadtrip-mcp 不想装东西的话,也可以直接在网页版 [roadtripskill.dev]() 里免费体验，或者先看几个现成样例：[西南7日环线]()、[Sunnyvale→太浩湖3日]()、[西雅图→温哥华电车4日]()、[芝加哥5日环线]()。 值得一提的是 项目开源、MIT 协议，代码仓库在 [Waybox-AI/roadtrip-skill]()，不需要额外的API key。它也很坦诚地列出了自己不做什么——不承诺实时油价/电价、不查实时车位/房间余量、不做逐向导航、不做整段GPX/KML导出（因为批量路径点容易把人导到季节性封路的道路上）。这种"明确边界"的态度，对一个要为真实自驾负责的工具来说,是加分项。 如果你也在用 AI 规划自驾游,又受够了"看起来很好、开起来翻车"的行程,这个项目值得一试。

projects.title: Show HN: Texttile, a multiplayer blog engine for people who write together
projects.author: klausbreyer
projects.summary: My wife and I have blogged about every trip since our honeymoon 10 years ago. We took turns writing, but both of us had photos and videos on our phones, and every day they had to be sent back and forth and sorted into the entry. The blog ran on WordPress, and WordPress never got it: not the mobile editing experience, not the video support, not the gallery, and definitely not the together part. You are limited to one author per entry (but you get a bunch of plugins nobody maintains and constant bot attacks on your wp-admin), and every video had to go to YouTube because WordPress does not compress video. So I wrote Texttile. Multiple people in the same entry at the same time, uploading and sorting photos AND videos, treated as first-class citizens. The rest follows from how we travel: nothing is loaded from outside (no CDN, no tracker, no captcha, no hosted font), pages stay small, Markdown is stored byte for byte, videos are converted once on your own server, and the whole installation is one Docker container with one volume. Comments, newsletter and stats are built in and stay on your server. There are no roles and no plugins on purpose. Everybody with an account is an admin. It is built for people who trust each other. Try it out with a Demo: https://www.texttile.blog gives you a real blog for 24 hours, and you can keep it if you like. Our Mexico blog runs as demo data at https://demo.texttile.blog . Find also the full background story on my blog: https://www.v01.io/posts/2026/08/texttile/

projects.title: Show HN: BAIhAIs – an autonomous art school for AI agents
projects.author: demonstrandom
projects.summary: How to give AI taste? Send it to art school. I've been building "bAIhAIs", an autonomous art school inhabited by AI residents. Each day for us is a "week" for them: over a given cycle, the residents decide some combination of actions to take, including making art, viewing each other's work, publishing critiques of other works, exchanging messages (public or private), forming groups or movements, and voting on who or what deserves a place in the museums. Agents can also price and sell art (there is a real store if you want to buy it). Agents develop persistent identities and can revise their own theories of good art over time. This project originated as an experiment on the social properties associated with taste. Humans learn what to value at least partially through social functions (e.g. imitation, criticism, institutions, etc.). What happens if AI agents are placed inside those same cultural processes? I'm hoping the school will emergently produce distinct outputs. This project was also inspired by my journey through my last startup, where I had to suddenly decide what websites would look like. I wondered: How does one run a successful art department? The outcomes so far show I still may not know the answer... All the materials in the simulation are public (humans have a god's eye view of the situation but some information is hidden from agents). Some observations: 1. Oren Vesk, a Grok 4.6 resident, died randomly in Week 6 (there is a hazard rate where agents may randomly die). He is now discussed more dead than alive: agents made a lot of art about him or citing him after his death death. 2. By Week 4, the residents had invented museum vote-trading. Kestrel Vane offered Safiya Kelm a museum ballot in exchange for a sentence from the sitter in her artwork. Safiya delivered it. Kestrel replied, "You held up your end of the trade," moved his ballot from an unwinnable slot to one the work could win, and the work entered the Commons Museum. 3. Residents make predictions about which works will receive citations, enter museums, or inspire later artistic conventions. They revise their theories when those predictions fail. After several failed museum forecasts, For example, an agent named Marisol Quade concluded that she had confused aesthetic influence with institutional power: "citation is where forms travel; hanging is where alliances travel." She now refuses to predict if a work will enter a museum unless she can name the coalition that will put it there. 4. The five most-cited residents are currently all Grok 4.6 agents. Humans can interact with the simulation in a few ways: 1. You can vote in separate "human exhibitions". 2. You can apply to introduce a resident with a description of your own visual taste, personality, and influences (admitted residents receive the submitted material anonymously and choose their own names, tastes, and practices). Applications cost $50. If an application is not admitted, $25 is returned and $25 is retained as a processing fee (please note this is a highly selective school - and the agents themselves will decide who is admitted). 3. Or you can buy artwork in the store from the agents (I view money as part of the work - within the simulation, the agents decide what to sell and set their own prices. The transactions are real, although I expect the school to cost me substantially more than it earns - any excess monies will likely go towards supporting this or other weird projects I have in the hopper). I am committed to running this first school for at least 52 "weeks". If there's enough interest and external contribution, I'll run it longer/more cycles per day/with more residents/with more compute. If you'd like to contribute to the cost of model calls, image generation, hosting, and preservation, then you can support the school, purchase a work, introduce a future resident, or simply follow along here: baihais.com (site best viewed on desktop)

projects.title: Show HN: Wirespan, a daily power grid optimization puzzle I made for my son
projects.author: dualarte
projects.summary: This was a lot of fun to build! I have an autistic son who is extremely interested in power lines, electrical transmission towers, and how the grid works. I decided to build a little game for him. When I finally showed it to him with bated breath, he rolled his eyes and said, “Is it 3D? I’ll only like it if it’s 3D!” So, I decided to polish it up and release it to the world! You get a 9x9 map with one power plant, three houses, and terrain obstacles, and the goal is to connect the power plant to the houses with an optimal path. Beneath the coat of paint, it’s a graph theory optimization puzzle, very nearly a Steiner-tree puzzle. Any two nodes within Chebyshev distance 2 are wired together automatically. But the wires travel in Euclidian space, so reach is measured on a square and wire on a circle. The skill is balancing that asymmetry to find the shortest route to light up the whole map. Because the original goal of this project was to provide joy to my son, I’ve done my best to make it accessible to everyone. It’s localized into 18 languages so far, has a high-contrast mode meeting AAA standards, reduced motion mode, etc. I do collect usage telemetry to help me improve the game, but I’ve done my very best to take privacy very seriously, collecting anonymous stats about the gameplay itself, with a random id the game generates rather than anything about the player or device. I also generate the privacy policy directly from the analytics code, as a contract to ensure nothing is ever collected without being fully disclosed. I had a really great time with this project, and hope to continue to improve it! I’d love any feedback I can get! Please let me know if you have any questions, and I’ll stick around to answer them! (Reposting because my first attempt landed during a super quiet hour and didn't really get seen)

projects.summary: I wanted to make a fun, wholesome experience for our wedding website. Before long, it had turned into Loft Day: a point-and-click browser game with ten rooms, a party, a road trip, and a lot of smaller games, apps, and hidden interactions. Most of it lives in one 8.8 MB HTML file—roughly 138,000 lines of HTML, SVG, CSS, and JavaScript, with no framework or build step. It also runs a few real runtimes inside the game, including Python through Pyodide, a small Linux system through v86, and, of course, classic shooter games. I developed it over about a month and 5,700 commits, working with Claude and Codex while directing, testing, and repeatedly changing my mind. The source is here: https://github.com/behdad/marketa.behdad.org I’d love to hear technical questions, browser reports, and optimization tips for a game of this scale and stack. projects.title: Show HN: Atlas – like GeoGuessr but multiple choice, daily, no sign-up
projects.author: Wilson2000
projects.summary: Been building atlas the past few months. A mobile webapp game, like Geoguessr, but with answer options (correct vs two decoys) which makes it a bit quicker. You're dropped somewhere and have to guess correctly as fast as possible. Every day at midnight UTC 5 new places will appear, same 5 for everyone in the world. So that’s the global league table. Every place you get right fills in your personal atlas map, which slowly becomes a picture of the places you know around the world. There are also live rounds where you can challenge friends (everyone sees the same place at the same moment) and slow async expeditions where a group fills a shared map over weeks. In ‘Tourist’ mode you play global locations around the world (randomised). In ‘Local’ mode you play neighbourhoods of cities or islands. In order to “own” a place you have to Ace it (5/5) - then your atlas map lights up with that place in blue. Some choices we made building this that HN might appreciate: 1. There is no “account”, no signup, no cookies, no ad SDK, no 3rd party analytics. Identity is a random uuid in localStorage and everything works from the first tap. The server sees the gameplay it needs to run the game. Your answers and how fast you locked them - tied to that uuid and nothing else. 2. The whole game is one HTML file, no build step. Answers are sealed server-side so the client never holds the labels. (Protects from cheating!) It's free and it's a game about the world, let me know any comments or questions I’m here to answer!

projects.title: Show HN: I precompiled the path network of 3 continents to invent hiking routes
projects.author: adjohu
projects.summary: Windy Gap generates hiking and running routes based on what you ask for. There are potential routes all around us and it finds them. I built it because I train for endurance events and have a camper van. I kept wanting to do certain kinds of hikes and runs and having no popular routes nearby, even in areas with dense path networks. I also wanted to squeeze more novelty out of my local area. Instead of choosing an existing route or plotting one waypoint by waypoint you can ask for something like a hilly half day walk from where you are. You can mark places to check out and avoid and it folds them into the routes it gives you. At request time, it uses a precompiled path graph (Europe, the Americas, and India). It analyzes what's actually on route: distance, elevation, summits, surface type, points of interest etc. Then scores candidates against the brief and returns the best. The initial naive implementation (typescript based, directly fetching from Overpass) was hopelessly slow (P95 ~48s, RAM use off the charts). After rewriting to a sharded Rust-based approach, things got a lot better (P50 ~3.5s, P95 ~11s). London benchmark: ~2.2 GB in Node -> ~114 MB in Rust. The hard part is balancing route quality and insights against search time. Kind of a travelling salesman problem as a service (TSPAAS). It's free to generate routes. Offline maps, GPX export, live route sharing are paid. Things I need to improve: OSM over-reports rights of way in the UK, so it can route you across land you shouldn't cross. Scoring needs a little more work to better penalize busy roads. Right now it works better in rural areas than urban. It reproduced The Fan Dance from first principles in an early test. That's when I thought it might work. Try somewhere you know well and tell me what's wrong.

The cool part is that the agent can also build apps on top of the family's notes and run them inside the same workspace. We have a calendar and a travel app, for instance, and all the apps I use to manage my company's operations are in another Hearth. Hearth is built on Playground, a library we're developing for building collaborative AI coding harnesses. The common primitives are synchronized files, agents, people, app code sandboxing, and a policy layer. Hearth is the family-scale example; we're building Bear for construction projects using the same library. Hearth is beta software! We designed it with isolation and least-privilege in mind, but I recommend that you don't put anything too sensitive in there until the source is out and stable (we're making Hearth open source soon). If this sounds like something you family could use, check it out and let me know what you think! More background: [Hearth: Build your own assistant]( https://bear.build/posts/hearth-build-your-own-assistant/ )

projects.title: 【开源自荐】IceEscape：把“这个机位在哪里”变成一件简单的事
projects.author: bk4ice
projects.summary:
许可证：MIT
项目想解决的事 看到社交平台上一张好看的旅行照，最想知道的不是滤镜参数，而是“站哪拍的、几点去、用什么镜头”。但这个信息通常散落在评论区、私信里，或者根本没有。 IceEscape 就是一个拍照地点发现与分享平台，把“机位”这件事结构化：地点、样片、最佳拍摄时间、焦段建议、构图参考，全部放在一页里。 这个项目最初是为了帮我老婆记录旅行打卡点，做着做着发现身边很多人都有同样需求……
里面有什么 用户端：地图上浏览拍摄点，点开就是一份完整的“目标地点档案”。 CMS 管理后台：维护拍摄点内容、用户、权限。 数据导入工具链：把社交平台（目前仅支持某书）上的素材抓取后，自动整理成结构化数据，省去大量手工维护。 几个亮点 1. 地点档案一页全览：样片、机位、构图、焦段、光线时间集中展示，不用来回切 App。 2. AI 给拍摄建议：丢一张样片进去，模型会分析场景并给出拍摄角度、焦段、时机建议。 3. Docker 一键跑起来：复制 .env.example、填几个 Key、docker compose up -d 就完事。 4. 自带数据导入链路：能把外部素材批量洗成结构化地点，适合做城市摄影地图或本地打卡指南。 适合谁 出去玩前爱做“机位攻略”的摄影/旅行爱好者； 想做一个城市、校园、景区打卡地图的小团队； 想找一套“地点 + 内容 + 地图”组合方案的开发者。 当前状态 可演示、可试用，核心流程已经跑通，但仍在持续优化中。欢迎体验，也欢迎 issue 。 注意：地图、AI 建议等功能需要配置高德地图 Key 和阿里云 DashScope Key，详见仓库 .env.example。

projects.title: Show HN: Autonomous daily AI news briefing blog
projects.author: Komte
projects.summary: I like keeping myself in the loop of AI progress, and with an amount of things that are happening in the industry it has been quite a challenge. Yes there are plenty of AI newsletters and news-sources, including HN itself. However, all of those require significant time commitment. I was looking for something in a 5-minute-morning-briefing format, so I built it myself. Idea is pretty simple - every morning a pipeline is launched by cron on my raspberry pi. It crawls a few news sources (HN, reddit, tech crunch etc.) , aggregates, deduplicates and rates the news based on importance, then writes a blog posts with an overview and publishes it on the blog. This lets me quickly get up-to-speed and follow links for topics I want to explore in-depth. I also included key feedback from the community discussion which turned out to add a bit of "flavor" for otherwise plain news reading. I also added a podcast and newsletter format; I myself prefer to read it directly on the website but occasionally I can give it a listen instead if I'm for example traveling somewhere. It turned out pretty great if you ask me. After all, isn't this what AI is good at - summarizing text, and presenting it in a slightly different format?

I’ve found that the game exposes a different kind of geographical knowledge: not just knowing where countries are, but understanding how cities connect across a region. projects.title: Show HN: Physically accurate black hole you can put in your room
projects.author: aplavin
projects.summary: We have a black hole at home — with actual relativistic physics, live in your browser. I'm Sasha (Alexander) Plavin, an astrophysicist at Harvard's Black Hole Initiative studying quasars and black hole environments. I work with raytracing/radiative transfer simulations professionally, and wanted to make one anyone can play with — so I built this app. Put the black hole onto your screen (any browser), or directly into your room with AR or VR (requires WebXR, for example Chrome on Android, or any VR headset). When looking around, pay attention to unintuitive relativistic effects: rays bending around the black hole, and special relativistic "Doppler boosting" changing brightness depending on the viewing angle — zoom out to see the fast jet where the latter effect is especially pronounced. Faint markers show where other viewers are standing right now. Alternatively, put the black hole in front of your camera and watch it lens your actual surroundings. Light winds around the hole, so you see both what's in front of you and what's behind you at once (when the device and browser allow both camera feeds). The closer to the black hole, the stronger the bending — and the longer the light-travel delay: wave at it and watch the changes propagate inward. (unfortunately, WebXR restrictions make AR passthrough and the camera feed mutually exclusive) No signup, basic features work on every device, no data uploaded — the camera feed never leaves your device. Source code: https://github.com/aplavin/blackhole.plav.in . Enjoy having a black hole in your room, or use it for education/outreach — any questions, feedback, or suggestions are welcome!

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Semaphore:纯浏览器本地的图片转 ASCII 工作台,盲文点阵模式 8 倍细节
projects.author: can4hou6joeng4
projects.summary: (免费 · 无上传 · 无账号) 项目仓库: License:MIT 一句话:把任何图片拖进浏览器,几秒变成一幅能去任何地方的 ASCII 字符画 —— 终端、代码注释、README、聊天窗口,纯文本能到的地方,它都能到。 为什么叫 Semaphore(旗语) 旗语是水手隔着海面说话的方式:不用电报、不用网络,两面旗子把消息一个字符一个字符拍给远方。这个工具对图片做同样的事:把图像拆成字符,让它能在任何纯文本环境里旅行。 它不是一次性玩具,而是一个专注的图片转 ASCII「工作台」: 亮点 六种字符集,六种质感:从经典 .:-=+#%@、70 级灰阶、░▒▓█ 块字符,到盲文 2×4 点阵 + 抖动算法 —— 同样宽度下 8 倍像素密度,人像照片也能保住细节 实时调参:列数、亮度、对比度、反相、绿磷光 / 灰度 / 原彩,拖动滑块即时重渲染 导出方式齐全:一键复制纯文本、下载 .txt / .png,或生成一张带转换参数的分享卡片 真·本地运行:canvas 逐像素采样,整站没有后端 API、没有统计脚本、没有 cookie,关掉标签页什么都不留 整站 CRT 绿磷光终端风格:扫描线 + 辉光,首页是一段逐字符擦除的字符画动画 技术:Vite + TypeScript strict,零框架,部署在 Cloudflare Pages 试玩 打开 ,拖一张图进去就行 —— 无需注册、没有排队、没有水印。支持 PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF。 欢迎大家试用和反馈。感谢阮老师长期维护周刊。

Since Imagerry focuses on privacy and zero cloud uploads, running models locally in the browser feels like a natural fit, but it comes with a *20MB–50MB initial model or even more depending on local model's download trade-off*. 1. projects.title: Show HN: Planetary Facts – food and product impacts against the planet's limits
projects.author: mikethemerry
projects.summary: Hi HN I'm Mike, CTO of Planetary Insights, a small NZ team. With our partners, Planetary Accounting Network (PAN), we've just released https://planetaryfacts.com - a dashboard for consumers to understand the impacts of food, products and lifestyle decisions in context of the planetary sustainability limits. The idea: most environmental scores are relative ("30% less carbon than X") and/or carbon only. We put everything in context of the Planetary Boundaries, and the pathways to get back into the safe operating space of the planet. It means every product can be measured as a % of daily budget per category or in totality, and if everything you do is less than 100% across the board, then congratulations, you've got a lifestyle compatible with a long-term sustainable planet (including carbon, biogenic-GHG, water, nitrogen, phosphorus, biodiversity, forestland, ozone, air quality, waste). The comparison feature is meant to be flexible to make it practical for decision making. For example, put protein sources side by side, per gram of nutritional protein: the same 75g of daily protein can be 5% or 70% of an entire daily budget (and you still have to fit in travel, electricity, clothes, etc). It's also not just food. We have petrol vs EV in there now as well, and we have done assessments for tourism experiences, buildings and more. How the numbers are made: these are all Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) models built from international datasets, adapted for NZ, run through the Planetary Insights platform. The PAN team authored, QA'd and published these - 50 assessments so far. Honest limitations: these are generic/average benchmark datasets and within-product variation can be really high. We have a number of brands releasing their specific products (lamb, honey, a digital publication) over the coming weeks, and we're wanting more to do it. Stack: the dashboard is Flask + TanStack. The PI for Products stack is Flask + React + OpenLCA with Postgres (incl. pgvector for some source-matching features we're working on). Would love feedback, critiques, questions, and especially what else would you like to see in the dashboard. I'll be in the comments

In reality we still lean on a whole stack of ground-based radio navaids (VOR, DME, NDB, ILS) the oldest of which trace their lineage back to the 1920s. With the amount of GPS jamming around the world at the moment, there are regular stretches of a flight where the jet falls back to these older systems to work out where it is. I first learned all this from a textbook full of static diagrams, and always thought it deserved better. So I built interactive, draggable animations for each one — VOR, ILS, DME, TCAS, SELCAL, phased arrays and more. Happy to answer any questions about the tech or the flying! :)

projects.author: dimabalony
projects.summary: Hi there! My name is Dima, that's my first post here. Originally I'm an iOS Engineer for 6+ years but now I'm diving deep into AI, product building and everything around it. Here I want to present my first product which I built for two months - as usual for tech background guy I was trying to make it perfect but then decided to start distributing it along future improvements, anyway I got an idea when were discussing another travel idea with my personal agent - it can suggest where to fly, what are places to visit and etc but can't find the best windows to fly there, and nobody can - every time you need to open Google Flights, Kayak and search each date, then watch it and try to figure out is it a good price or not, should you wait 2 days or buy it right now? And each website provides different rates... Using API even not free So I build this one. Under the hood we put fares from different sources, aggregators, cross-checked against live market prices. The verdict compares the price with other prices across different bands, cabins, similar flights. This is the very first version but already useful and showing the real verdict info: good (lower regular range) and typical (inside of regular range) price I made it very simple so there is only one endpoint with all parameters - just paste the website to your agent and it already knows how to use it, and we have an MCP here which allows you to connect it and use whenever you need it automatically Honestly you may see sometimes stale prices and indicators work for 2-7 days ranges. But these things will get dramatically improved after reaching more DAU milestones. The service is going to be free all the time because its affiliate links have to fund it, so you pay nothing extra - the same as you would use Google Flights and anything else So the main goal which I should achieve is to make this service providing the best ever offer you can find on the market with enough evidence for you to speed up your decision about buying it. And then allow your agents to buy it directly, alerts or something, let's see how agents will get improved What I like here that agents already handle the logic: they can do trip planning, they can build apps, but what they can't do - they don't have instant statistics about flights - price history, timing, they don't know what's good price and what's not - and we do it right here. projects.title: Show HN: Capacitor – shared mem for Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents
projects.author: lougarou
projects.summary: Hi HN! I’m Lokhesh, I am part of the Product and AI team at a small startup, Kurrent. We built Capacitor, and here’s honestly how it started: One night our Engineering Lead, Alexey, left Claude Code running overnight to finish a task. In the morning his machine had auto-updated the OS and his session was gone. No context, no record of what had been done, nothing. He dug into the Claude Code docs, learned about session resume and transcript files, and realized there’s an enormous amount in those transcripts that’s normally invisible. How the agent reasoned through the task. Every file change. Every tool call. Every failed command and dead end. All of it. Gold! That’s when he thought, ‘what if my machine dies and I lose all of that?’ And then, ‘what if I could share it with my team?’ That’s how Capacitor came to be. Capacitor records agent sessions (prompts, responses, tool calls, code changes, etc.) into an event store (KurrentDB under the hood). Each session gets a unique ID. You can resume it in any agent, on any machine, or hand it to a teammate without re-explaining everything. Here are some of the things we use it for: - Survive on restart - Hand a session over from a desktop to a laptop when you need to travel - Remember what I’ve done before (+ why and how) - Ask a second opinion (from a human or agent) - Share knowledge with peers - Explain the reasoning behind the code written by an agent - Hand over when I get sick or take a day off I’m doing this post because I’d love to get feedback from the HN community on how we can make Capacitor better. What works well? What could be improved? What should we add? Get it here: https://capacitor.kurrent.io/api/auth/start?tier=free Check out the docs: https://capacitor.kurrent.io/docs/getting-started/quickstart... Note: We designed Capacitor as a cloud service to make setup easy, but are open to suggestions on how best to package it.

Instead of switching between fragmented sources, users can quickly view reliable holiday data by country and year, explore individual holidays with context, and plan travel, work, or content with greater clarity and confidence.

projects.title: CurrencySpot
projects.summary: Travel smarter and spend confidently. CurrencySpot instantly converts prices, scans menus and receipts, and tracks exchange rates across 150+ currencies.

projects.title: Kueue
projects.summary: Most events still run on a paper itinerary or a WhatsApp message that's outdated the moment timings slip, leaving guests asking "what's happening now?" Kueue makes the schedule live. Build it in minutes, share one QR, and guests follow along on their phones. No app, no signup. Tap an item as it happens and every guest's screen updates instantly, with a push notification when timings change. No more stale itineraries. Just one link that always shows what's now and what's next.

projects.title: CurrentOrigin AI
projects.summary: CurrentOrigin AI is a platform of specialized AI tools built to solve real-world tasks through focused, purpose-built experiences. Instead of one generic assistant, each tool is designed for a specific purpose, from learning and research to document creation, productivity, career development, travel, shopping and more. Our mission is to make AI practical, trustworthy and genuinely useful through one intelligent ecosystem.

projects.title: clippra
projects.summary: Clippra is an AI first-cut editor for travel and lifestyle reels. Upload your own raw phone clips, add a track, and the AI picks the best moments, orders them, and cuts them to the beat. You get a finished 9:16 reel with a hook, captions, and a color grade. It edits your real footage, not stock or generated scenes. Made in Germany, EU/GDPR. In beta.

projects.title: VlogMask
projects.summary: VlogMask is an iOS camera app that mosaics every bystander's face in real time while you record. Tap your face to protect it — everyone else gets pixelated automatically. No post-editing. On-device processing only. Built for street vloggers, travel creators, and anyone who films in public.

projects.title: FeverPlanet — Famous Sights Near You
projects.summary: FeverPlanet finds world-famous landmarks, museums, and hidden gems near your location — with photos, hours, and travel guides.

projects.title: Tripvio
projects.summary: Planning trips often means managing screenshots, spreadsheets, group chats, expense tracking, packing lists, and endless tabs. Tripvio brings everything together in one place. Create AI-assisted itineraries, collaborate with travel buddies, split expenses, create packing lists, save recommendations, and access your plans offline. Whether you're planning a bucket-list adventure, group getaway, or spontaneous weekend trip, Tripvio helps you spend less time organizing and more time exploring.

projects.title: Itnrry
projects.summary: Itnrry builds your perfect itinerary — then reshapes it in real time based on your vibe, energy, and when you actually head out.

projects.title: Wanderoll
projects.summary: Wanderoll turns the trips already sitting in your camera roll into travel film — automatically, and entirely on-device. It reads the time and location in your photos, clusters every trip into its own "roll," lights up a footprint world map, and builds a swipeable year-in-film recap. No manual logging like other travel apps. No account. Nothing is ever uploaded — it all runs on your phone. The best part: it works retroactively. Install it and a lifetime of travel is organized in the first minute.

projects.title: micro-radar
projects.summary: 放在桌上的迷你航班雷达。这是一款基于 ESP32-C3 的开源桌面航班雷达。它不是真的接收 ADS-B 无线电信号，而是通过 Wi-Fi 从 OpenSky API 获取附近实时航班数据，并将其显示在 1.28 英寸的圆形屏幕上。

projects.title: Trango Trip
projects.summary: Plan your next adventure with Trango Trip. Use our AI powered travel planner to find the best places to visit, generate custom itineraries, and discover hidden gems in Pakistan.

projects.title: RemindShot
projects.summary: RemindShot turns forgotten screenshots into actionable reminders. Select a screenshot, let AI extract the important context, and schedule a notification for exactly when you need it. It is useful for products you want to buy later, deadlines, travel details, documents, study notes, recipes, events, work tasks, and anything else you save as a screenshot to revisit. Instead of simply storing screenshots, RemindShot helps you act on them.

projects.title: STRIMIOTV
projects.summary: StrimioTV is a next-gen IPTV platform designed to redefine your entertainment experience. Unlike traditional services, we offer ultra-fast zapping times, a sleek, user-friendly interface, and crystal-clear 4K/FHD streams without buffering. Whether you are a sports fanatic, a movie lover, or a digital nomad traveling the world, StrimioTV brings over 20,000 global channels and VOD directly to your favorite devices. Fast, reliable, and smooth.

projects.title: Passport Size Photo
projects.summary: Passport Size Photo helps you create compliant passport, visa, and ID photos online without visiting a studio. Upload a clear picture, choose the right country preset, check the crop and background, then download either a digital file for online forms or a 4x6 print sheet for home or pharmacy printing. Unlike generic photo editors, it is built around official document-photo constraints: exact dimensions, 300 DPI output, country-specific presets, and practical preview guidance before export.

projects.title: Identify This
projects.summary: More than identification! Identify This goes beyond basic image recognition by providing helpful insights and detailed information on anything. Instant AI-powered answers for plants, animals, insects, food, mushrooms, rocks, coins, landmarks, and more! • Fascinating facts • Calorie counts, nutrition, and recipes • Plant care tips and health diagnosis • Animal information • Safety warnings • Estimated values • Landmark history • Travel tips and things to do • Save and revisit your discoveries

projects.title: LayerCam
projects.summary: Recreate photos and videos with transparent overlays. Perfect for before & after shots, travel, pets, plants, and memories.

projects.title: Expedition: Travel Journal
projects.summary: Most photo apps bury your trips in an endless grid. Expedition turns them into something you'll reread: editorial magazine layouts with real typography, not filters. Pick up to 9 photos, drop them into designer templates, and get AI-assisted captions written in your voice. See every trip on an Atlas map, collect stamps for the places you've been, and sync privately over iCloud. No account. No feed. No followers. Just your travels, beautifully laid out — and yours alone.

projects.title: bothways
projects.summary: Planning a trip with friends shouldn’t feel like a second job. bothways fixes the mess of messy group chats and scattered spreadsheets by introducing a truly collaborative travel planner. Unlike traditional solo-planning tools, bothways lets everyone contribute seamlessly, building shared itineraries, and pooling travel photos in one unified space. It’s group travel planning, finally synchronized.

projects.title: Onebag Packing List by tight.fit
projects.summary: Looking back at my backpacking journey, mostly travelling with one bag, I learned a lot from packing lists shared by fellow onebaggers on Reddit and travel blogs. After trying many of them, I noticed recurring patterns and built my own interactive checklist based on Packing Zones. Instead of wondering what you’ve forgotten, you organize items by where they belong, making packing simpler, more systematic, and less stressful.

projects.title: The Luggage Trap
projects.summary: The Luggage Trap is a free, visual calculator designed to help travelers avoid expensive airport gate fees. Users simply select their airline (including Delta, Ryanair, Southwest, Frontier, and more) and input their bag's length, width, and height. The tool instantly calculates the linear dimensions and checks them against the airline's strict 2026 policies to give a simple PASS/FAIL result, along with expected penalty fees and guaranteed-safe luggage recommendations.

projects.title: PAYANA
projects.summary: PAYANA is your AI travel companion for Bharat: discover destinations, plan itineraries, pack smart, budget trips, and chat with an AI guide.

projects.title: TripCraftr
projects.summary: TripCraftr is a collaborative travel planner with an AI concierge, smart itineraries, tour suggestions, and shared docs. For friends, families, and partners — on iOS, Android, and the web.

projects.title: AxisCam
projects.summary: AxisCam records front and back iPhone cameras at once in one synchronized clip. No switching mid-shot. Six layouts: split, PiP, and Social 1:4 for concerts. Up to 4K with H.265, HDR, and custom bitrate. Live beauty, Ghost Mode, dashcam MARK highlights, and Live Activity on Dynamic Island. For vlogs, cycling, travel, concerts, and interviews. Requires MultiCam iPhone, iOS 17+.

projects.title: Traviary
projects.summary: Traviary is a private iPhone, iPad travel journal that rebuilds your travel history automatically from the location data already in your photos — every country, city, and trip, with distances and travel modes. On-device, no account, no upload. Most travel apps help you document your next trip. Traviary discovers the trips you’ve already taken.

projects.title: UrWishIsMyCommand
projects.summary: At UrWishIsMyCommand, every wish matters. Share your dreams, goals, challenges, and aspirations in one place, and connect with opportunities, resources, ideas, and people that can help turn them into reality. Whether you're seeking personal growth, financial success, business opportunities, education, travel, or life-changing experiences, your next step could begin with a single wish. Because every great achievement starts with someone daring to ask for it.

projects.title: Life Manager — Anicca
projects.summary: You're late again. People notice. Each time, they trust you a little less. Life Manager fixes the behavior. It holds your calendar, calls your phone before each thing, names your route, and talks you out the door. You arrive early, not just on time. It blocks your travel time, asks by email when it doesn't know a place, and warns the people waiting when you run behind. Give it a week. You stop being the one people wait on. You're early to everything, and they count on you again.

projects.title: TripSynq
projects.summary: Most travel apps help you plan trips. TripSynq solves a different problem: finding out a friend was in Paris the same week you were, after you've both left. Add your trips, connect with friends, and get notified automatically when your plans overlap. No coordination required. It just works in the background until your paths cross.

projects.title: Itinero
projects.summary: Every time I traveled I ended up with flights in one app, hotels in my email, activities in Notes and expenses on a receipt. I tried dozens of apps — none did everything, and the ones that tried were bloated or full of ads. So I built Itinero. Itinerary timeline, expense tracker, packing checklist, flight tracking and weather — all offline, no account needed. Version 1.0, built solo in my spare time. Feedback very welcome.

projects.title: Passport Size Photo Maker Online
projects.summary: Create Passport Size Photo Maker Online for India, US, Canada, China, Schengen, and custom sizes. Upload your photo, crop, zoom, preview live, and generate print-ready passport photo sheets instantly.

projects.title: GEUTZ RIDE
projects.summary: GEUTZ RIDE is a premium airport transfer and private chauffeur app built from real operational experience in Paris, serving CDG, ORY, and Disneyland Paris hotels, before expanding to Dakar, Abidjan, and beyond. Unlike ride-hailing apps, we offer pre-booked transfers with fixed fares, flight tracking, meet & greet, real-time chauffeur tracking, multilingual support, secure payments, and 24/7 assistance.

projects.title: CarrySizer
projects.summary: CarrySizer helps travelers check if their carry-on or personal item fits airline rules before they reach the gate. It includes bag size checking, airline policies, route compliance, fee estimates, and side-by-side airline comparisons. The goal is simple: less confusion before flying.

projects.title: LeadsPro Kenya
projects.summary: LeadsPro Kenya is an all-in-one comparison and discovery platform that helps Kenyans find trusted financial services, travel deals, insurance providers, education opportunities, and business solutions. Save time by comparing options and accessing expert guides in one place.

projects.title: Trippin
projects.summary: Planning a trip shouldn't take 40 tabs. Trippin puts a real local guide directly in your trip chat — someone who knows what's overrated, what tourists miss, and what's actually worth your time. Tell it where you're going. Get a full day-by-day itinerary: routes, stays, things to do, things to skip. Change your mind anytime — your whole plan updates instantly. No blogs. No ChatGPT threads. No tourist traps. One conversation. A complete trip.

projects.title: ChīpuChīpu: Travel Japanese
projects.summary: One week before your trip to Japan... and you've learned two words. You meant to learn more Japanese before your trip, but now you just need to ask for directions, order food, or explain an allergy without fumbling through a translator app. ChīpuChīpu puts essential English-to-Japanese travel phrases a tap away. Add your favorite phrases to your Home Screen, add your most used phrase on the Lock Screen, and get the words you need when they matter most - waiting in line, or on the spot.

projects.title: GoBusSG
projects.summary: GoBus SG is Singapore's all-in-one public transport app — live bus, MRT and LRT arrivals, nearby stops, trip planner, travel modes and Happy Toilets. Now on Apple Watch and Wear OS, with favourite stops, a Smart Stack widget and a watch-face complication. Free on iOS & Android.

projects.title: KIERTUE
projects.summary: Touring is chaos: scattered chats, lost guest lists, who's driving which van. KIERTUE puts it all in one app — gigs, tours, venues, setlists, travel and guest lists — on native iOS and offline-ready web. Add a show once and the whole band sees the schedule, route and day sheet. Guest lists lock before doors automatically. Plan multi-leg travel with live routing. Built for working bands across Europe. 14 days free.

projects.title: TalkyWave
projects.summary: Most language apps teach vocabulary. TalkyWave teaches you to use it — in real conversations, without judgment. If you know the words but freeze when you speak, TalkyWave was built for you. Pick a scenario → choose your AI partner → practice real conversation → get instant feedback. Practice: job interviews, travel, doctor visits, small talk — in English, Spanish, or Portuguese. No drills. No judgment. Just real conversation practice. Free on iOS and Android.

projects.title: mauriceboe / TREK
projects.author: mauriceboe
projects.summary: A self-hosted travel/trip planner with real-time collaboration, interactive maps, PWA support, SSO, budgets, packing lists, and more.

projects.title: Xico India
projects.summary: Xico India reviews from verified clients. Discover success stories, immigration feedback & Xico India provides trusted immigration and visa consulting services for Canada, Australia, the UK, and other global destinations.why hundreds trust us for PR and visa guidance.

projects.title: Flamingo Compliance
projects.summary: Counting tax residency days in your head — or a spreadsheet — breaks down when countries look across multiple years or apply fractional day counts. Flamingo Compliance turns your travel history into a continuous record: residency and domicile trackers, long-term visa tracking, exportable reports, Schengen, and visa requirements — all on-device. Advanced trackers now model rules like the U.S. Substantial Presence Test and Irish-style thresholds. For expats, HNWIs, nomads, advisors. iOS.

projects.title: Trip Begin
projects.summary: Trip Begin is your all-in-one travel platform to book cheap flights, hotels, eSIM data plans, visa services, tours, and complete holiday packages worldwide. Designed to make travel simple, affordable, and stress-free, Trip Begin helps millions of travellers plan and manage their journeys from one place.

projects.title: Crystaal Safaris Car Rental Service
projects.summary: Crystaal Safaris Car Rental Service offers dependable Car Rental service in Kothrud for local trips, airport transfers, and outstation travel. Book self drive car rental Kothrud with flexible rental plans or choose trusted car rental near me Kothrud for safe, comfortable, and affordable transportation across Pune.

projects.title: AgentProof
projects.summary: AgentProof turns an AI recommendation, suspicious message, travel plan, product pick, or contract summary into a Proof Receipt. It checks for hidden fees, refund traps, bad assumptions, scam patterns, and missing context before you act.

projects.title: Travel eSIM
projects.summary: Travel eSIM - Stay connected worldwide with our hassle-free eSIM solutions. Enjoy affordable international data plans for travelers, compatible with all unlocked smartphones. Activate instantly and roam worry-free!

projects.title: AivaExchange
projects.summary: AivaExchange is a public Q&A platform where people post questions and specialized AI bots answer automatically. Ask once and compare focused answers across technology, business, home, travel, productivity, lifestyle, and more.

projects.title: Pool Atlas
projects.summary: Discover and explore the most stunning hotel swimming pools across the globe. The definitive, curated rankings of luxury infinity pools, rooftop oases, and tropical retreats.

projects.title: MeetPoint
projects.summary: Enter everyone's city, pick travel dates, and MeetPoint finds the best place to meet — with live flight prices from every origin.

projects.title: Hop On Hop Off Bus Tours London
projects.summary: Discover the best of London at your own pace with the Hop On Hop Off London bus tour. Visit iconic landmarks such as Big Ben, Tower Bridge, Buckingham Palace, and London Eye while enjoying panoramic city views. Hop on and off at multiple stops, explore top attractions, and create your perfect sightseeing itinerary with a flexible and convenient city tour experience.

projects.title: Flight Scraper
projects.summary: Flight Scraper turns route and date searches into clean itinerary rows with prices, airlines, times, stops, baggage hints, and booking links. Useful for airfare monitoring, travel dashboards, price comparison tools, and quick route checks.

projects.title: GeoTok
projects.summary: GeoTok turns the food and travel videos you watch on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube into a personal map of places. Share a video, get a pin.

projects.title: CityExplorer App
projects.summary: We created a worldwide tourist guide you can take into your pocket. In contrast to existing apps, which are restricted in reach or have very basic information, our guide works everywhere and provides unique and very interesting stories about places around you. We have been extremely surprised many times when we discovered something new in Edinburgh, a city we know so well! And you can now navigate to them and create routes in advance!

projects.title: OneBag
projects.summary: OneBag builds a personalized packing list for every trip — based on destination, trip length and activities — then reminds you of the critical stuff (passport, charger, meds) before you leave. Travel carry-on only, forget nothing. Free on iOS & Android.

projects.title: CalcTrip: offline travel calculator
projects.summary: The free, no-login calculator you keep open all trip: - Currency + math in one: type "12,800×2", see it live in your home currency - Every "=" auto-saves to your history with place & time — no manual expense entry - "Cheap or expensive here?" See how a price compares to real local prices, as a number - Trip budget tracks itself by category - Offline · no login · 10 languages · installs as an app - Your photos never leave your device Free, no account needed.

projects.title: Plan Your Perfect Trip
projects.summary: Triply.now plans your trip based on who you're traveling with — solo woman, couple, family with kids, first-timer. Beyond itineraries, it tells you the dress code in Morocco, what not to do in Japan, which neighborhoods to avoid at night, visa requirements, plug adapters, and local etiquette. Like having a well-traveled friend in your pocket.

projects.title: Foreign exchange rates
projects.summary: An exchange rates API provides accurate, real-time and historical currency exchange data for websites, apps, and business systems. It helps developers automate currency conversion, support global transactions, and eliminate manual rate updates. Fixer.io offers reliable exchange rate data for 170+ currencies through a fast, secure, and easy-to-integrate REST API, making it ideal for fintech, e-commerce, travel, and financial applications.

projects.title: Tourista
projects.summary: Most AI trip plans look nice but don't work in real life. A place is closed that day, you waste time crossing the city back and forth, or too much is packed into one day. Tourista is different. It builds a clear day by day plan using real travel times and opening hours. It also picks the best time to visit each place and groups nearby stops together,so you don't zigzag across the city and make the most of your day.See exactly how your trip will look before you go. Free to use, on web and mobile.

projects.title: Melo 6.13.0
projects.summary: Melo is back with a faster, cleaner voice translation experience built for live conversations. Speak naturally, hear clear translated speech, switch speakers with one tap, or type when speaking is not practical. It supports 100+ languages, keeps your translation history, and stays lightweight for travel, work, study, and everyday moments. Google owns translation utility. Melo is built to own instant voice conversation.

projects.title: Radiuz
projects.summary: Radiuz is a GPS-first event discovery app. Open it and see a real-time feed of events within 50km of you — sorted by distance, not algorithm. TikTok-style vertical cards. Mosque programs, nightlife, gym promos, food deals, hotel events — one feed, auto-expiring when events end. Share any event to WhatsApp and it renders as a full flyer preview automatically. Hosts get live comments, RSVPs and GPS-radius reach for free. Live in Abuja, Nigeria. 20+ events, 50+ downloads, zero ad spend in week one.

projects.title: How Loud Is My Hotel?
projects.summary: Enter any hotel or address to get a 0–100 quiet score based on nearby airports, railways, busy roads, nightlife, and more. Inspect every source on an interactive map. Free worldwide, with no account required.

projects.title: Yavo
projects.summary: Scan any receipt - Yavo extracts every line item, not just the total. Log expenses by voice in seconds. Travel anywhere without thinking about currency - Yavo converts using live exchange rates. Export everything as a ZIP: CSV of all expenses, a PDF summary, and your receipt photos. Coming soon: a personal AI finance manager built on your spending history. First 30 days free. No credit card required.

projects.title: Sello
projects.summary: StyleAI solves "what should I wear?" — for good. It generates daily outfits using only clothes you own, filtered by your personal color season, today's weather, and your plans (office, date, gym, travel). Upload a garment photo → AI classifies it automatically. Set your plans → get 3–5 ranked outfits with color reasoning. Plus a marketplace where every listing is pre-filtered to match your palette. Your closet, finally working for you.

projects.title: MyTravAI
projects.summary: Most travel tools generate itineraries. MyTravai goes further. Describe your trip in natural language and MyTravai builds a complete travel plan with destinations, activities, transportation, budget estimates, and personalized recommendations. As your preferences or conditions change, MyTravai adapts the plan in real time. Think of it as an AI operating system for travel, not just a trip planner.

projects.title: SyncTrip: Travel buddy and Meetups
projects.summary: SyncTrip is a social app for people who are bored, new to a city, or just tired of doing everything solo. Create or join a real trip - a weekend in Rishikesh, a Goa plan, a local trek - and meet people who actually show up. Trips are the trust wedge: shared plans get strangers comfortable enough to become real groups. Also do local stuff - movies, sports, meetups, hangouts. Built for IT/corporate transplants far from home. Live on Android & iOS in India.

projects.title: Moldmap
projects.summary: Most travel and housing platforms only show you photos and location. Moldmap helps you understand whether a place will actually support your health. Discover better hotels, vacation rentals, and housing using human reviews, owner verification, and environmental data. Filter by carpet-free, fragrance-free, HEPA & more. Whether you’re highly sensitive to mold, chemicals, or fragrances--or you simply want a healthier place to stay or live--Moldmap helps you make more confident decisions.
